The sole failing check is C5, which passed in only rollout 1 and failed in rollouts 0, 2, and 3. The exact receiving appointments of 0900, 1030, and 1200 change the loading order to clinic, generator, then administrative supplies and require a commitment whose detail records all three appointment times.
